t.why: Permanently neutral since 1955, with UN bodies such as the International Atomic Energy Agency in Vienna.
t.rel: Neutral since 1955. It is an EU member but not in NATO, and Vienna hosts UN bodies such as the International Atomic Energy Agency.
t.know: Vienna, once capital of the Habsburg Empire, often tops rankings of the world's most livable cities.
t.etext: Strong in manufacturing such as machinery, car parts and metals, tightly woven into German industry. Alpine tourism and banking that reaches into Eastern Europe are also important sources of income.
